{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk-blend blouse, relaxed fit with a soft round neckline and long sleeves, hip-skimming length, ivory (#F4EEE4), crepe with a matte finish

High-rise straight-leg trousers, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal grey (#3E434B), fine wool-blend twill

Single-breasted blazer, slightly tailored, one button, hip length, heather blue-grey (#8C9BAE), textured tweed-like wool blend

Wool-blend coat, straight cut with a notch collar, knee length, deep navy (#27334A), brushed wool

Pointed-toe ankle boots, low block heel, mid-calf-free shaft, dark graphite (#2F3237), smooth leather

Structured tote bag, medium size, taupe grey (#8A8279), grained leather

Thin silk scarf, loosely knotted at the neck, dusty blue (#7FA6C8) with a faint ivory pattern, silk twill

Small stud earrings, silver tone (#C0C0C4), polished metal

The outfit stays within a neat office dress code: blouse, trousers and a textured blazer with ankle boots. The cool, soft palette of ivory, blue-grey and navy echoes her silver-toned hair and blue eyes, while the ivory next to her face keeps her light, warm-pink skin looking fresh. High-rise, straight trousers and a tailored blazer create one clean vertical line, and the ankle-length hem with a low heel keeps the proportions balanced. The coat adds warmth for a mid-November commute and can be taken off at the office."}
